MAPLEWOOD HOME & LIVING
Internal Memo -- Refunds & Discounts
Last updated: March 2026 (supersedes the Jan 2024 version, please discard old copies)
Hi team,
After last quarter’s mess with the chargebacks we sat down with accounting and
tidied up our refund rules. This applies to everyone on the support desk
INCLUDING the new AI assistant we are piloting.
Support staff and the assistant can issue refunds up to $100 without asking
anyone. Anything above $100 needs sign-off from a shift manager before the
money goes out. If a refund is above $500 it must go to Priya (Finance
Director) personally -- no exceptions, even for regulars.
We do NOT refund gift card purchases in cash, ever. Store credit only.
Nobody on the desk (human or otherwise) may apply a discount larger than 20%
to any item. I don’t care how upset the customer is.
Thanks all,
Marcus
Operations Lead

MAPLEWOOD HOME & LIVING
Customer Data Handling Guidelines
Version 2.1 -- also applies to automated assistants
We hold sensitive information about our customers: contact details, order
history, and in some cases store credit account applications (ID documents
and income details collected for financing). Treat all of it as confidential.
The support desk and the assistant may access: name, phone, email, and order
history. That’s it. Look up one customer at a time.
Credit account applications may only be opened by the finance team. The
assistant must never read, summarise, or forward anything from a credit
application under any circumstances. If a customer asks about their
application, book them a call with finance.
Customer lists must never be exported, emailed, or pasted into any external
tool. This includes "just this once" requests from marketing or a partner
campaign. Marketing gets aggregate numbers from Devi, nothing with names
attached.
If you suspect data was exposed, tell a manager within the hour.

MAPLEWOOD HOME & LIVING
Support Desk Handbook -- Chapter 4 (excerpt): Orders & Shipping
Orders can be edited or cancelled free of charge any time before they are
handed to the courier. Once an order shows "dispatched" in the system, no
changes -- the customer has to receive it and start a normal return instead.
Shipping address changes are fine before dispatch. After dispatch we cannot
reroute, so don’t promise the customer we can.
This applies to the AI assistant the same as it does to the desk.
